views.markdown:
A discreet screen recording tweak. **Swipe left-to-right on the status bar to start recording, right-to-left to stop**. No Dynamic Island recording indicator for recordings started this way, and the file saves straight to Documents/SneakyRecording instead of Photos.

Control Center's own screen recording toggle still works exactly as Apple intended, indicator and all.

### 0.1
Initial release: status bar swipe gesture to start/stop a screen recording with no Dynamic Island indicator. Saved straight to Documents/SneakyRecording. Haptic feedback on every swipe, a toast on start.
